title: AgentHarnessPersonaSummary
description: One persona in the agent harness list, as returned by `GET /v1/agentHarness/personas`. The context figures are read from the context cache and never compiled for the list.

harnessAdditions.description: What a persona harness adds to the default, counted from the harness's published settings.

glossaryTerms.description: Glossary terms picked one by one.

rules.description: Context rules that are not picked lists.

userCount.description: Distinct active users who have the persona directly, through a team, or as their default persona.

harnessId.description: Id of the persona's harness. Absent when the persona has none and its members get the default.

enabled.description: The persona harness's `enabled` flag. Absent when the persona has no harness.

additions.description: What the persona's harness adds to the default. Absent when the persona has no harness.

enabledEvents.description: Hook events at which the persona's members receive context, with inheritance applied to the published harnesses.

characterBudget.description: Character budget in effect for the persona's compiled document.

charactersUsed.description: Characters in the cached compiled document. Zero when nothing is cached.

cacheState.description: State of the cached document. A persona with nothing cached reports `STALE`.

lastGeneratedAt.description: When the cached document was compiled. Absent when the context has never been generated.
